purpose: Lightweight RF shadow baseline on static algorithm recognition; no promotion of ML candidates into proven implementation evidence
first_experiment_scope: C/C++ source and x86_64/AArch64 ELF. Other architectures counted as outside scope and never represented as ML coverage.
truth: Reviewed named source functions / DWARF-aligned function ranges. Function names and source identities used only in offline truth, not features or inference.
split: Grouped by upstream ancestry, project, source implementation and compiler-runtime lineage; OpenSSL/BoringSSL grouped, GmSSL versions grouped; no random build split. Group CV on development chooses hyperparameters/thresholds.
primary_threshold_policy: Per-algorithm out-of-group development threshold maximizes recall with file-algorithm FP rate <=0.5%; if infeasible disabled. Also report a predeclared relaxed <=2% operating point. Candidate threshold uses audited crypto functions, not all target-negatives.
final_holdout: New predeclared author projects only; lock truth before scoring; no validation-driven feature/model/threshold edits.
holdout_note: Candidates checked for prior presence/ancestry/licenses before inclusion. Failed/unavailable/overlapping projects disclosed and excluded; missing algorithms explicitly reported.
comparisons: statistics-only vs CFG/memory vs local-call feature ablation
historical_validation_policy: Historical evaluated projects are read-only fixed regression, never called fresh holdout; not used as training input this round.
completion_criteria: Train and freeze reproducible RF; independent new-family scan; TP/FP/FN and scope/limits recorded. No promise of 90% recall.
source_preparation_supplement: Two planned repositories returned404 before any feature extraction/model scan. Unscanned fallbacks: marcizhu/ChaCha20, skeeto/rc4, maandree/libmd5.
source_preparation_addendum: Before model training or any holdout scoring: exclude micro-ecc because historical references already contain its family; add hacl-star/hacl-star and RustCrypto/elliptic-curves for broader held-out algorithm coverage, and rurban/smhasher for hard negatives. Same no-scoring-until-freeze protocol.
